           '' AS candidate, 
           Candidates || char(10) AS rest
    FROM my_table

    SELECT District, Candidates,
           substr(rest, 1, instr(rest, char(10)) - 1),
           substr(rest, instr(rest, char(10)) + 1)
    FROM split 
    WHERE rest != ''
),
candidates_only AS (
    SELECT TRIM(SUBSTR(candidate, 1, INSTR(candidate, '(') - 1)) AS candidate_name,
           CAST(REPLACE(SUBSTR(candidate, INSTR(candidate, ') ') + 2, LENGTH(candidate) - INSTR(candidate, ') ') - 1), '%', '') AS REAL) AS pct
    FROM split
    WHERE candidate != ''
)
SELECT candidate_name, pct
FROM candidates_only
ORDER BY pct ASC
LIMIT 1;
</SQL>
